incidents.name: GHT token transferFrom missing allowance check
incidents.notes: GHT.transferFrom() moved tokens without checking the caller's allowance, so the attacker emptied the WETH/GHT Uniswap V2 pair's GHT reserve, called sync(), pushed the GHT back in and swapped the resulting imbalance out for WETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: ERC1967Proxy 0x528e046ACfb52bD3f9c400e7A5c79A8a2c2863d0 created 2024-03-05T14:11:47Z by 0x2aa1eccb2dcb0c1ffd44abc6c92fcdd4d26fdc10, not the attack-tx sender 0x096f0f03e4be68d7e6dd39b22a3846b8ce9849a3; two EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 19376972 on 2024-03-06T15:17:11Z installing 0x17dfb09194ab77dcf318839cfdd01f587a73a77e — 13.3 hours before the exploit.
